test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

No one have ever paid me such a nice compliment.
solution:
The correct answer is '**have ever paid me', i.e. this part contains an error.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **Have **with **Has**.
 
• We use ***no one, nobody, nothing, and nowhere*** to refer to an absence of people, things or places. We use them with **a singular verb**:
 
 
• Nobody ever **goes **to see her. She’s very lonely.
 
 
 
• Hence,** Option 3** is the correct answer.
 
• The correct sentence is: No one **has **ever paid me such a nice compliment.
